author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado goes yard Sunday
desc: Manny Machado went 1-for-2 with a home run and three RBI in the Padres 5-2 win over the Dodgers on Sunday.
impact: Machado went deep in the seventh inning to help the Padres end an eight-game losing streak. It was his fourth home run in eight games to stay hot.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JP Sears earns win Sunday
desc: JP Sears allowed one hit over five scoreless innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a win on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: Sears delivered to help San Diego end its eight-game losing streak. If he remains in the rotation, he'll face the Blue Jays over the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Garver hits home run Sunday
desc: Mitch Garver went 1-for-3 with a home run in the Mariners 4-0 win over the Blue Jays on Sunday.
impact: Garver took Trey Yesavage deep in the fourth inning to extend the Mariners lead to 3-0. He continues to backup Cal Raleigh behind the plate for Seattle.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock deals seven scoreless innings Sunday
desc: Emerson Hancock allowed two hits over seven scoreless innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a win on Sunday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Outside of a double hit by Vladimir Guerrero Jr. in the first inning, Hancock kept the Blue Jays lineup in check all afternoon at home. He'll look to close out a very strong first half of the season this weekend in Tampa Bay.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Geraldo Perdomo collects three hits Sunday
desc: Geraldo Perdomo went 3-for-5 with one run in the Diamondbacks 3-2 loss on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Perdomo doubled and scored in the first inning. He later added two singles and a stolen base.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eduardo Rodriguez records quality start Sunday
desc: Eduardo Rodriguez allowed two runs on five hits over six innings with three strikeouts in a loss on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Rodriguez threw six scoreless innings before allowing a single and home run in the seventh inning right before he was removed. He'll take a stifling 2.25 ERA into a start against the Dodgers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Reynolds goes yard Sunday
desc: Bryan Reynolds went 1-for-5 with a home run in the Pirates 11-5 win over the Nationals on Sunday.
impact: Reynolds went deep off Cade Cavalli in the third inning. He is up to 13 home runs and 56 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Lowe hits home run Sunday
desc: Brandon Lowe went 1-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Pirates 11-5 win over the Nationals on Sunday.
impact: Lowe capped off a five-run eighth inning with a three-run long ball for Pittsburgh. He is slashing .242/.316/.498 with 21 home runs and 63 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bubba Chandler takes no-decision Sunday
desc: Bubba Chandler allowed four runs on six hits over four innings with four walks in a no-decision on Sunday against the Nationals.
impact: Chandler did not record a strikeout, while walking four. He struggled after starting his day tossing a pair of scoreless innings. He'll face the Brewers before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lazaro Montes promoted to Triple-A
desc: Mariners top prospect Lázaro Montes has been promoted to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Montes is the No. 3 prospect for Seattle, per MLB Pipeline. He projects as a high upside power bat with some swing and miss concern. He will look to continue crushing baseballs in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ranger Suarez exits Sunday with adductor tightness
desc: The Red Sox say Ranger Suarez has left adductor tightness.
impact: Suarez was removed early from his start on Sunday. He'll continue to be further evaluated into Monday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jonah Heim drives in six in loss to Marlins
desc: Jonah Heim went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Marlins with a home run, one run scored, and six RBI.
impact: Heim continues a steady stretch at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The 31-year-old remains one of many streaky options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, slashing .241 with nine home runs, 29 RBI, and 20 runs scored through 46 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Gage Jump shelled early in loss to Marlins
desc: Gage Jump allowed six earned runs on eight hits and three walks while striking out one over three innings in Sunday's 9-8 loss to the Marlins.
impact: Jump has provided mixed results on the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in four of eight contests. The left-hander remains one of many inconsistent options in the Athletics rotation to this point, posting a 3.98 ERA and 1.30 WHIP with a 3-3 record and 8.6 K/9 ratio through eight starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Bauers goes yard in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Jake Bauers went 1-for-4 in a win over the Diamondbacks with a two-run home run.
impact: Bauers has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 11 contests. The 30-year-old continues to flash an explosive bat as one of the more streaky options in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, carrying an .861 OPS with 16 home runs, 54 RBI, 51 runs scored, and five stolen bases through 79 games.
